title: Pure Mystic Swordsman
summary: Pure Mystic Swordsman LV build with EARTH Warrior deployment helpers and face-down disruption staples. Every Mystic Swordsman automatically destroys face-down Defense Position monsters at the start of the Damage Step without flipping them face-up or calculating damage, then levels up during the End Phase after winning a battle.

summary.title: Starters
points: Reinforcement of the Army searches Mystic Swordsman LV2, Mystic Swordsman LV4, Marauding Captain, or Goblindbergh.

Marauding Captain and Goblindbergh Special Summon Mystic Swordsman LV4 from the hand in face-up Attack Position when Normal Summoned, bypassing LV4's restriction that forces it to be Set when Normal Summoned.
Level Up! sends a face-up Mystic Swordsman LV2 or LV4 to the GY to Special Summon the next stage directly from the hand or Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Marauding Captain + Mystic Swordsman LV4
steps: Normal Summon Marauding Captain and use its effect to Special Summon Mystic Swordsman LV4 from the hand in Attack Position.
Set Book of Moon, Book of Eclipse, or Quaking Mirror Force to flip the opponent's attackers face-down, or activate Level Up! on LV4 to bring out Mystic Swordsman LV6 from the Deck.
Attack a face-down monster with Mystic Swordsman LV4 to destroy it at the start of the Damage Step, then send LV4 to the GY during the End Phase to summon Mystic Swordsman LV6 from the Deck.

summary.title: Face-Down Execution & Draw Lock
summary.text: Mystic Swordsman LV2, LV4, and LV6 all slice through face-down Defense Position monsters at the start of the Damage Step before Flip effects or damage calculation can occur. Once Mystic Swordsman LV6 is on the field, instead of sending a face-down monster it destroys to the GY, it can place that monster back on top of the opponent's Deck, clearing their board while locking their next draw.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Mystic Swordsman LV6 is the Main Deck payoff, combining 2300 ATK with automatic face-down removal and top-of-Deck draw locking.

Blade Armor Ninja and Heroic Champion - Excalibur are Rank 4 Warrior Xyz options made from Mystic Swordsman LV4 and Goblindbergh; Blade Armor Ninja grants a Warrior a second attack to clear two face-down monsters in one Battle Phase.
Ferocious Flame Swordsman boosts all Warriors by 500 ATK and floats into a non-Link Warrior from the GY, while Aussa the Earth Charmer, Immovable steals an EARTH monster from the opponent's GY.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Book of Moon, Book of Eclipse, and Quaking Mirror Force force the opponent's face-up monsters into face-down Defense Position so the Mystic Swordsmen can destroy them regardless of ATK or DEF.
Moon Mirror Shield ensures Mystic Swordsman LV2 and LV4 also beat face-up Attack Position monsters in battle to trigger their End Phase LV evolution.
Phoenix Gearblade grants a Warrior a second attack during the Battle Phase, and Living Fossil revives Mystic Swordsman LV4 in face-up Attack Position without needing to Set it.

main: Mystic Swordsman LV2

Base Level 2 EARTH Warrior (900 ATK): at the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacked a face-down Defense Position monster, immediately destroys that monster without flipping it face-up; during the End Phase, if it destroyed a monster by battle, sends itself to the GY to Special Summon Mystic Swordsman LV4 from your hand or Deck!
Mystic Swordsman LV4

Mid-tier Level 4 EARTH Warrior (1900 ATK): must be Set if Normal Summoned, but when Special Summoned in Attack Position (by LV2, Level Up!, Marauding Captain, or Goblindbergh!), automatically destroys any face-down Defense Position monster it attacks at the start of the Damage Step and evolves into Mystic Swordsman LV6 during the End Phase!
Mystic Swordsman LV6

Boss Level 6 EARTH Warrior (2300 ATK): automatically destroys any face-down Defense Position monster it attacks at the start of the Damage Step AND lets you place that destroyed monster on top of your opponent's Deck instead of sending it to the GY—locking their next draw!
Marauding Captain
Special Summons Mystic Swordsman LV4 or LV2 from your hand in Attack Position on Normal Summon.
Goblindbergh
Special Summons Mystic Swordsman LV4 or LV2 from your hand in Attack Position on Normal Summon.
Level Up!
Sends a face-up Mystic Swordsman LV2 or LV4 to the GY to immediately Special Summon Mystic Swordsman LV4 or LV6 from your hand or Deck in face-up Attack Position.
Book of Moon
Flips any face-up opponent's monster into face-down Defense Position so Mystic Swordsman LV2, LV4, or LV6 can immediately destroy it without damage calculation or Flip effects.
Book of Eclipse
Flips all face-up monsters on the field into face-down Defense Position.
Moon Mirror Shield
Ensures Mystic Swordsman LV2 and LV4 also destroy face-up Attack Position monsters by battle to trigger their End Phase evolution into LV4 and LV6.
Living Fossil
Equip Spell that revives Mystic Swordsman LV4 from the GY in face-up Attack Position.
Phoenix Gearblade
Equip Spell that recycles itself and grants Warriors a second attack.
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Mystic Swordsman LV2, LV4, Marauding Captain, or Goblindbergh.
Quaking Mirror Force
Permanently flips all opponent's Attack Position monsters into face-down Defense Position so your Mystic Swordsmen can wipe them out and top-deck them with LV6!
